text.p: - Slovenia is undoubtedly in the first round of candidates for full membership of NATO, Prime Minister Janez Drnovsek said on his return from the United States.
- Professor of psychology Anton Trstenjak, member of the Slovenian Academy of Science and Arts since 1983, died on Sunday aged 90.
- Slovenian exports to former Yugoslav republics rose 35.8 percent in the first seven months from 25.1 percent in 1995, the Statistical Office reported.
- PHARE programme for regional development aid was transferred to the Foreign Ministry from the Ministry of Science because of Slovenia's closer ties with the European Union.
- Burglaries rose to 326 in the first eight months from 219 in the same period of 1995. Ljubljana accounted for 50 percent of burglaries.
- Due to financial problems just two transplants were made at Ljubljana's Clinical Center this year.
